psychological_meaning: Muesli, a muted and earthy brown, evokes a sense of groundedness, stability, and natural comfort. It represents simplicity, honesty, and a connection to the earth. This color often inspires feelings of reassurance and dependability, reminiscent of wholesome foods and a comforting, rustic environment.
